source_description: QA bug reward [normal] to Tim: Bartender daemon 同 tick 內多 trigger fire 造成 Discord mirror duplicate broadcast — tokens=2 trigger 預期 fire 2 次 (seq 864 + 865), Discord 卻收到 4 條 (每 seq 重複 2 次). Root cause hypothesis: daemon 在 same tick 內 fire 兩個 bartender post → 各自 spawn notify_discord.py → race condition (state file last_seen 未及時更新, 兩 process 都看到 unseen msgs). Tim 截圖 confirmed. (ref: bartender-mirror-duplicate)
